landmarks.name: First Beacon
landmarks.note: The permanent arrival and travel anchor; it never degrades.

landmarks.name: First Beacon tents
landmarks.note: The authored starting camp is primarily tents with room to grow.

landmarks.name: Beacon fire
landmarks.note: A communal fire gives the camp a shared gathering place.

landmarks.name: Mara the Builder
landmarks.note: The fixed foundational builder provides dependable construction help.

landmarks.name: First Beacon noticeboard
landmarks.note: The board names local needs and communal work.

landmarks.name: Shared cache
landmarks.note: A collection point for the camp's useful materials.

landmarks.name: Crude tool rack
landmarks.note: Fallback tools keep foundational work available without a specialist.

landmarks.name: Common fields
landmarks.note: Nearby shared plots provide the simple farming entry path.

landmarks.name: Whisperwood edge
landmarks.note: Nearby trees mark the foundational logging ground.

landmarks.name: Shallow stone seam
landmarks.note: Nearby stone and ore-bearing ground mark the mining entry path.

landmarks.name: Rough forge
landmarks.note: The camp forge connects ore, fuel, timber components and useful tools.

landmarks.name: Storehouse site
landmarks.note: A visible unfinished site reserves room for the first communal project.

interactions.note: Fresh characters arrive at the permanent beacon.
The settlement state can identify its starting tents.
The communal meeting point is addressable by stable ID.
Local needs have a world location rather than only a menu label.
Fallback access is explicit and can later be balanced against crafted tools.
Plant, tend and harvest use the existing authoritative farm records.
Logging work will be attached to this world record in F2.
Mining work will be attached to this world record in F2.
The connected production proof remains owned by F4.
The visible communal construction loop remains owned by F6.

locations.name: The Hearth
locations.access_note: The open settlement is the reliable entry point for new players.

locations.name: Whisperwood Watch
locations.access_note: A pioneer can enter through a watch, repair, or caravan role.

locations.name: Saltmere Landing
locations.access_note: The landing is open to carriers and a service vacancy even when busy.

routes.name: North pack road
routes.note: A threatened road can be repaired, escorted, or delayed without deleting a journey.

routes.name: Saltmere ferry
routes.note: The ferry is slower than a finished road but keeps the landing supplied.

routes.name: Watch trail
routes.note: The frontier trail is a recovery opportunity for scouts and repair crews.
